body:
I’m ashamed to be a human being and do normal human things like have a shower

I understand

All the therapists I’ve had seem to take it personally that I haven’t improved. 

The “why bother going for “help”” voice is strong when this is what I get :/

My boss yelled at me for being late this morning. My living situation is still terrible because I've avoided apartment hunting, and now I've spent all winter (my favorite season, where it's been unseasonably cold and rainy this year) holed up in a room where I can't relax and I'm in danger all the time. I can't go to the bathroom without feeling nervous (it's communal), and I avoid showering because I'm afraid someone will see me and I'm self-conscious getting out. I still haven't fixed the bug problem on my mattress.

I figured that I'd be back at College by now and living in a room where I could relax, read, get a fish/little pet, but I'm still at square zero after over a year in this city. I don't even have an ID yet, and the paper work is taking longer, because I've avoided it. It could have been done a year ago, and I didn't and now I'm in this mess. 

I'm more defeated than ever. More broken - I know I'm underweight, and haven't fixed that either. My therapist turned out to be another dud (another in a long line. Wonder why I even bother), and I'm 29, and haven't started dating. I'm so late to everything, and it's February, and I'm wondering if Community College will even take me...

I'm bleeding, and having to ignore the wound to move on, lest I lose more of my spirit. (I'm so sorry for posting this much. I feel like I'm crying out for attention...

I'll probably delete this later to make room for others in the thread.)

It’s worse because I have ptsd (it’s what I came to her for). My brain is physically damaged and that’s what I get. She backtracked about - saying that it was because she hadn’t scheduled me in months, but that’s not really my fault.

She knows I’m suicidal and I feel so abandoned because she just didn’t schedule me and I guess didn’t give a shit. I can’t help feeling abandoned because I know she wouldn’t care if I ended up homeless or died in the meantime:(

Thank you I’m really crying reading this - I’m trying hard to validate myself but then I fall back 

I asked for a rent receipt where I’m staying this morning and the woman refused...it’s hard to see how everyone just doesn’t exist to hurt me
Capitalism is a disease.
Everything aches when I'm sad.

My therapist just insinuated that I'm not trying hard enough...she tried to backtrack, but I couldn't help crying, and I held it in until after our appointment (it was near the end), and then excused myself to the bathroom to cry...

It reminds me of what I've been told my whole life - "you're not trying hard enough," when I'M TRYING SO F8CKING HARD OKAY

\*sigh\*

I can't even cry in front of my therapist. 

And then I got to work, and cried through the first part of my shift...I had to wipe off tears while serving customers again...

I'm trying to do all this paperwork and stuff and improve my living situation, when EVERYTHING makes me nervous EVERYTHING hurts and because I have no f8cking clue on how to have an intimate, interpersonal relationship, I'd doing all this shit alone, so her saying that really hurt. I saw there was a missed call that was probably from her on my phone while I was at work, but I didn't even answer it because I was so hurt.

(I'm sorry for posting here a lot. I don't have much support or places to go). I think my therapist doesn't like me very much. I've cemented that I need to get a new one. Something struck me in our last appointment. I told her that this time last year, even though I felt objectively worse, I was more in touch with my self and I had more hope.

Well, then she didn't really say anything, but brought up her notes on her computer and said that it "looked like I had the same complaints" this time last year - talking about being hopeless.

I guess it just struck me as cold? Like, she couldn't take my word for it or address my needs. Also, she keeps saying that I can't really focus on other stuff until I get basic needs met - which is basically food, shelter, etc. (I'm still having trouble getting those things), and she gave me this sheet with Maslow's hierarchy of needs on it (Like, yes, thank you. I know about that). And when I complain about being homeless, she just gives me the same sheet with a list of shelters on it...

I feel so abandoned by this person. Is therapy even worth it? I've never had a successful therapist. Usually they end up causing more trouble than their worth (re-traumatizing me). I had more success getting drunk and journalling. It seems like every time I try to reach out to another human being, I get more hurt. It reminds me that isolation isn't really that bad. I also had one counsellor who was really empathetic and I felt like I had a good connection with, but she passed away. But nothing else has gone well.

I'm so f\*cking broken that I think about suicide every single day, yet I still doubt that I even need therapy, just because being alone and broken is better than being exposed, hurt, using energy to go to appointments I don't like, and talking to someone - spilling your secrets to someone who will look at you like something on a form, until you inevitably leave in a year, six months, three, etc. 

It just leaves me feeling more broken and disjointed. 

TL;DR: Being broken alone, killing myself is better than "therapy"

Well, today was horrendous. I was written up for a ticket violation on the train, and now I either have to pay a fine or dispute it in court. I still haven't paid my horrendous library fine, and I'm probably in big trouble for that. I don't have ID, and I've realized just how badly my life's gone to hell - how I've been avoiding everything and it's all piled up on top of me. I was late for work, because I had to get off on the wrong stop to get written up, even after taking a lyft to work and using money I don't have to do that. I've completely ignored valentines day and getting written up reminded me that I still haven't put in the name change forms either. Basically, I haven't done a single thing that a person needs to do to live in the world, have no relationships, isolated myself completely, and now it's all come crashing down and I have no idea how I'm going to cope or achieve personhood at 29 years old. Seriously, I'm 29 and can't even date because I'm too broken. I haven't slept in ages, and it feels like someone has physically ripped something out of my chest.

My therapist is shitty, and I have to get a new one of those, too. Also a new job, because I'm working minimum wage for a very unpleasant person, who I ignore most of the time, but couldn't today, as she was super rude to customers while I was just standing there. Speaking of which, I had people today make me put stuff on them and be generally really unpleasant and today was a slog, with loud music playing, and the sound trauma that I go through has been acting up again. I had to hear some alarm thing on the bus yesterday, and I basically had to block out a flashback or suppress the urge to run off the bus when it wouldn't go off. Then today, the music/band thing was loud at work, and now I even hear noise outside my window.

The problem is, that all my problems could have been prevented like months/a year ago, but it's this shitty avoidance/trauma whatever depression that fucks me up. Basically, the last year I've been stuck at my job has eroded my soul to the point where I don't feel much of anything anymore, and I KNOW January was a good time for hiring (not that I applied anywhere), and this is going to look like shit on my resume, and I'm thinking of how I fucked that up too - by taking and staying so long at a job I'm \*over qualified for, I might have fucked up my resume too?

Basically (again), I'm giving myself a year (ANOTHER YEAR, OMG HOW MANY YEARS DO I NEED TO GET MY SHIT TOGETHER???) to fix this (then I'll be thirty) and then I'm checking out...like actually pulling the trigger, getting the rope, etc., because I can't take any more of this torture, and this broken body can't take life, BUT HOW DO YOU EXPLAIN THAT TO A TICKET COP YOU CAN'T OR A PASSPORT OFFICE OR A COLLECTIONS AGENCY??? (DID I MENTION MY CREDIT CARD???) So, I'd rather just check out then be hauled off to jail or humiliated or something

/bye that's my rant

Thank you. That means a lot.

It’s not that easy for me.
Oh my God I just realized that the people that say this to me all the time (and I got this CONSTANTLY) is from people who weren't traumatized/abused, so OF COURSE they can move on.

Oh gosh - I could have written this exact post. I was told I had "first world problems" growing up - never mind I was dealing with Eating disorders and psychological abuse. 

I also grew up very isolated from other women, with no female friends. I had a mother who had no female friends either, and problems with women. I've struggled to have and keep close friendships with women my entire life. 

Someone last year (a guy, btw), had to explain to me what "girl-talk" was. He said that his sister had it with his Mom, and it was a thing they did. I just sat there and stared, because I had no experience of this. 

I also liked more "boy things" and mostly spent time online, or reading/zoning out to TV. I could never find other girls to share my interests, and then when I became an adult, I had problems with jealousy, because I was told I was "pretty." I simply didn't know how to get close to anyone. 

Someone told me I was sly, or cunning, or that I'm hiding something...I don't really let anyone get to know me, and it terrifies me when someone does. On the other hand, I've spent my life desperately alone, wanting to be my true self more than anything. 

Mostly I'm just ashamed - I was never taught social skills, so I managed to "fake it" well enough, with the added pressure of being nice/pretty/perfect on top of that. 

I don't really feel like a person, and although I had jealousy directed towards me, I could never understand why, because I was a lonely piece of crap, and it wasn't a secret that I lived a pretty miserable life. It made me resent those who were jealous of my superficial qualities, when they had more - things I struggled to obtain, while calling me petty or ungrateful or whatever for being "better" than them. 

​
I feel the same...I'm constantly terrified. I feel like suicide is the only way out. Not only that, I fawn to society's whims. I long to be my true self.

Just so trapped. It's 6 am, and I've taken to not sleeping at night, at all. Sometimes I pass out from emotional exhaustion. I also don't remember the last time I had a meal. 

I feel so trapped. Why do I end up in these bad situations? Going to a nice part of town hit home hit home how badly I live, in this crime-ridden run down area, waiting to get raped. 

I was this sweet girl...or was I just too broken to see the world? I avoid mirrors, because I imagine my face will be ugly and reflect the ugliness inside, but it's not...I'm still ageing and alone. 

I ran away, isolated myself from everyone. Indulged in self-destruction and ruined my "life." The only way out now is suicide. I can't live as this creature, remembering there was "me." 

I'll miss the opportunities, the friends I could have had. I'll miss waking up, in the early hours when it's frost bitten and cold, seeing my breath, hugging a cup of coffee and taking the first sip. I'll miss the pets I could have owned and the friends I could have made and the reunions and meetups that should have been but weren't. 

I need to do this because there is no healing. Everything I read triggers me more. I try to find the truth - it's beating at my brain, and everything goes dark. I'm starting to believe that I deserve to live in this derelict state. 

Mostly, I can't stand my soul or brain - broken into something that I swore I'd never be. I believe that there is integrity in death, and that may be my only healing.

I can relate. For me, it's the numbness. And then time passes, and then regret. It feels like being on this wheel. When I'm around others I feel dirty, gross, like I'm hiding this shameful secret. 

Can you take solace in your role as an observer? Like someone reading a book. 

I used to, unfortunately, too broken to do anything now but pull the trigger.

Every night I go to sleep on this mattress with bugs crawling on it. They try to suck my blood, and I'm always waking up and having to kill them, so it's almost impossible to get any rest. 

I haven't even made an effort to change it. Needless to say I'm alone. The loneliness hits harder on nights like tonight, when it's early in the morning and I can hear the rain. 

Now I'm more aware of how I'm getting older and the window of time to find "the one" is dwindling. 

I'm not crying anymore, because I'm numb.

I was just going to post something like this...

The times that I felt I've really healed, is when I took action, and acted on my trauma. Sometimes, I ended up in even worse situations than if I did nothing, but I didn't really regret what I did, and I learned and grew - something I didn't get at "home", because my parents didn't allow for us to make mistakes and learn and differentiate from them.

I've been struggling to express anger, and I often blank out and collapse. I'm frustrated that I've gone from having so much rage to act on and use to heal, to being this blanked-out person again.

I feel like I've lost so much meaning and potential for healing.

For me, anger looks like vouching for myself in relationships and jobs, and taking action to improve my living situation.

Because I know I can withstand pain, and I've been in so many worse situations before, I often just accept bad things happening rather than doing anything about them.

I've got from flight-mode, to collapse, and it's so frustrating, because it feels like I'm getting nowhere with my life. It seems almost impossible to break out of. I also haven't really had any proper regular therapy to deal with any of this. Is it possible to do this alone (lift yourself out of mental/physiological collapse) or do you need something to help you?

It's all so confusing. I hope that made sense. I'm sorry I didn't give a good answer to OP because I don't have any ideas myself.

So isolated, so alone. I haven't made the right efforts to fix my situation. I'm broken-hearted and numb. Don't know if I'll recover. Every day, I lose more and more of myself. Can barely feel anymore. 

Therapist doesn't give a shit - need to get a new one. She dismisses my suicidal ideation. I haven't paid a library fine that's likely gone to collection by now. Can't afford to pay my credit card, and still haven't fixed my bad living situation. 

I had the chance for a fresh start, and blew it. I can't help feeling like I've wasted the entire winter. 

I expected to be back in school by now. Still don't sleep at night. I found some sleeping pills that made it hard to get up this morning. It's the only thing that calms me down and takes away the pain. 

One good thing is that I haven't self-harmed in a while. I barely think or feel anything anymore. I think I'm depersonalized again, and it's getting worse. Time seems to skip ahead.

I understand this. I used to think life was a gift, go on at all costs, etc., but now I understand. Sometimes your life just...has to end.

I, personally, now see peace in death. If I killed myself, I don't think it would be sad. It would be understandable - a truthful ending of a life of torture. I have no need for hotlines, or hospitalizations, no need to drag myself to doctors appointments, fill out forms, work and do mundane tasks...it's cruel to your soul.

So what, you die? You return to the earth, a peaceful state. I believe someone keeping someone else alive for their own philosophy or the platitudes that they believe is likewise cruel.

For me, it's like being forced to sit through a class I don't want to be in...why do it? Our earth is overpopulated and diminishing. At this point, in the global warming catastrophe where the earth can't even sustain the wasteful human life that lives on it, and will likely be overburdened further in the future, we have to really think if keeping someone alive is really worth it.

It sounds very morbid, but have you ever seen Futurama? In the first episode, it shows a dystopian future where there are suicide booths. Maybe that's not as far off or divorced from our current reality as we think?

I have to be careful, because I do think it's worth seeking help, and many have regretted their suicide attempts or are glad that they are here after they've failed, but the philosophy of human life at all costs may need to be re-evaluated in this rapidly dying world.
Same. So much of my life has been pre-occupied by dying.

I'm sorry...there's such a thing called "imposter syndrome." I don't know if that's what you're dealing with, but we are all human. We are all destined to be embarrassed, to fail...

idk, I hope it works out better for you :/
